system.description: Beginning at 20th level, the resolve in your heart has reached its apex. Your will cannot be faltered and you are now able to stand against all your hardships in life with steadfast determination. While your Void soul is summoned, or you are gaining the benefits of Superego Manifestation, you and your Void soul gain immunity to all Mental conditions.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
